description: The only source of colour, type, spacing, radius, stroke, opacity and motion values for graph components. Specs name tokens as {group.name}; platforms read the generated files. Values are the web implementation's as of zegadb/zega@11cff10 (browser/theme.js, browser/components/canvas.css, path-on-map/index.js, arcs.js, globe.js). Lengths are points: 1 pt = 1 CSS px = 1 iOS point.

ground.description: Canvas background and land on the globe; label halos.

panel.description: Raised chrome (legend, gear, count badge); path casing; marker fill; place-marker ring.

park.description: Parks and green areas on the street map.

rule.description: Hairline borders of chrome; extruded buildings.

soft.description: Secondary text: legend ends, gear section titles and values.

accent.description: The one mark colour: solid paths, arcs, place markers, highlighted countries, form accents.

sequential.description: One hue, low to high value. Light theme runs light to dark; dark theme runs dim to bright against the dark ground. Sampled by linear RGB interpolation between equally spaced stops.

diverging.description: Two poles around a neutral middle stop. The middle maps to 0 when the data spans 0, else to the data's midpoint.

md.description: Gear grid gap; gear button to panel.

xl.description: Chrome horizontal padding; chrome inset from the canvas edge (top).

xxl.description: Overlay inset from the canvas edge (bottom-left).

planet.description: Margin kept around the whole planet when a globe view is fitted.

frame.description: Padding when framing data on a map, capped at a sixth of the canvas's shorter side.

casing.description: Added to a path's width for its casing (2 each side).

arc.description: Arc ribbon width, up to 300 arcs.

legend.description: Legend background: panel mixed with this share over the map.

gearPanel.description: Gear panel background share of panel.

highlight.description: Highlighted-country fill at zoom 5 and below; fades to 0 by zoom 9.

arcContext.description: Arcs not in focus when some are, up to 300 arcs.

arcContextDense.description: Arcs not in focus when some are, over 300 arcs.

gearButton.description: The gear button's width and height.

pulse.description: Radius of an animated arc's pulse.

ui.description: Chrome text (legend, gear, count). The system UI face today; see README open questions.

map.description: Labels drawn on a map surface, from the tile host's glyph set.

mapLabel.description: A path's label at its start marker.

caption.description: Letter spacing of gear section titles, in em.

instant.description: Camera moves on load and swap: views jump, never fly.

fast.description: Hover and press feedback on chrome, in ms.

swapBudget.description: Longest a load or restore may take to a drawn frame, in ms (APS 21).

dashSpeed.description: Animated arc dashes, points per second towards the target.

pulseSpeed.description: Animated arc pulses, arc lengths per second.

spin.description: Auto-spin at zoom 1.5 and below, degrees of longitude per second, westward camera (the globe turns east).
